snippet.title: The Starforge - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Starforge on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4088300/The_Starforge/

The Starforge is a short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.
